## GRAPHICS

CARDS TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS LIVE TO GAME_ *Extended warranty exclusions may apply based on country/region. Product Registration is required within 30 days of purchase on zotac.com.

SPECIFICATIONS

• NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 GPU 
• 10496 CUDA cores 
• 24GB GDDR6X memory 
• 384-bit memory bus 
• Engine boost clock: 1755 MHz 
• Memory clock: 19.5 Gbps 
• PCI Express 4.0 16x 

INSIDE THE BOX

• ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 3090 AMP Core Holo 
• 3-pin RGB Header Cable 
• User Manual 

POWER REQUIREMENTS

• 800-watt power supply recommended 
• 370-watt max power consumption 
• 3 x 8-pin power connector 

CONNECTIONS

• 3 x DisplayPort 1.4a (up to 7680x4320@60Hz) 
• 1 x HDMI 2.1 (up to 7680x4320@60Hz) 
• HDCP 2.3 support 
• Quad simultaneous display capable 

SOFTWARE COMPATIBILITY

• Game Ready Drivers and NVIDIA Studio Drivers 
• Microsoft DirectX 12 Ultimate, Vulkan RT API 
• OpenGL 4.6 
• Windows 10 64-bit (build 2004 or later) 

FEATURES

• HoloBlack Design 
• SPECTRA 2.0 RGB Lighting (compatible with external LED strip) 
• IceStorm 2.0 Advanced Cooling 
• Active Fan Control with FREEZE Fan Stop 
• PowerBoost 
• Metal RGB LED Backplate 
• GDDR6X Graphics Memory 
• 2nd Gen Ray Tracing Cores, 3rd Gen Tensor Cores 
• VR Ready, NVIDIA DLSS 
• NVIDIA NVLink (SLI-ready) 
• NVIDIA® GeForce Experience™ 
• NVIDIA G-SYNC® , NVIDIA GPU Boost™ 

EAN: 4895173623264 UPC: 810012082303

### GEFORCE RTX™ 3090 AMP CORE HOLO

• Depth: 99mm (3.9in) 

C O R E H O L O

®

#### HOLOBLACK

Get Amplified with the ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX™ 30 Series based on the NVIDIA Ampere architecture. Built with enhanced RT Cores and Tensor Cores, new streaming multiprocessors, and superfast GDDR6X memory, the ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 3090 AMP Core Holo gives rise to the absolute gaming experience with ultra graphics fidelity.

ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 3090 AMP Core Holo

ZT-A30900C-10P

為突破遊戲體驗而生的 ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX™ 30 系列基於最新 NVIDIA Ampere 架構打造，搭載效能增幅的 RT 光線追縱核心和 Tensor 核心、嶄新串流複合處理器以及極速 GDDR6X 記憶體。ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 3090 AMP Core Holo 以超高的圖像保真度，帶你走進全新的遊戲境界。

功能一覽： - 第二代 RT 光線追縱核心 - 第三代 Tensor 核心 - HoloBlack 全息極光設計 - SPECTRA 2.0 ARGB 燈效（支援連接外置 LED 燈條） - 改良版 IceStorm 2.0 冷卻系統 - Active Fan Control 智能風扇功能及 FREEZE 自動停轉功能 - PowerBoost 電流控制晶片 - 具 RGB LED 燈效的金屬背板 - FireStorm 應用程式 （ 按此下載） - NVIDIA NVLink 技術（支援 SLI）、VR Ready
